description: Golden set for the multi-word Assyrian translation endpoint. Each case pairs an English input with a reviewed expected Assyrian translation. Grow toward a few hundred cases, balanced across strata. Mark every reference as native-speaker reviewed before trusting the score as ground truth.

schema.input: English text sent to POST /api/translate as { text }
schema.stratum: category for per-group scoring: greeting | request | question | statement | tense | negation | gendered | idiom
schema.reviewed_by: who verified the expected output (e.g. 'native-speaker:sargon' or 'unreviewed')
schema.notes: optional context: grammar feature under test, known ambiguity
acceptable_alternatives: other Syriac strings that are also fully correct — credited if closer than expected.default.east
must_contain: one or more substrings (key vocabulary glyphs/words) that must ALL appear in the default output (AND semantics); NFC-normalized; whitespace preserved so multi-word entries match literally

cases.notes: First-person desire; 'want' conjugates by speaker gender, 'water' is invariant.
Common greeting; addressee gender changes the 'you' form.
Movement verb; tests 'go' conjugation and 'outside' adverb.
